paragraphs: My name is Zakaria Fattawari, a third-year Computer Science student at Kalimantan Institute of Technology. I am passionate about Web Development, Game Development, and Machine Learning. Currently, I am deepening my knowledge of database systems, deep learning, full-stack development, and software architecture to strengthen my technical foundation and broaden my expertise.

What I do is transform ideas into functional digital solutions. I design and develop responsive web applications, and explore intelligent systems using AI and Machine Learning. I enjoy working across the full development cycle from planning, designing system architecture, developing features, to testing.

Despite starting without a technical background, I continuously challenge myself to grow and adapt in the field of Computer Science. This journey has strengthened my problem-solving mindset, analytical thinking, and ability to learn independently. I am currently strengthening my foundation in databases, API development, and system architecture to become a well-rounded full-stack developer.

Beyond technical development, I am also active as a 'Pemandu' in Student Managerial Skills Training of Kalimantan Institute of Technology (LKMM ITK), contributing to leadership and organizational development among students. Through this role, I develop communication, teamwork, and project coordination skills that complement my technical expertise.
